request.state: Ticket #48213, opened Monday 09:14 by a customer on the Growth plan. Subject: payouts failing since Friday. Body: Every payout we scheduled since Friday evening shows as failed in the dashboard with the message 'bank rejected transfer'. Nothing changed on our side; the bank account is the same one we have used for two years and the bank confirms there is no block. We have 41 sellers waiting for their money and three of them have already emailed us asking whether the marketplace is shutting down. We need this fixed today or we will have to move payouts to another provider. First reply, Monday 10:02, support agent: Thanks for the report, I can see the failed transfers on our side and have escalated to the payments team; I will update you within two hours. Second reply, Monday 12:40, support agent: The payments team found that a routing table update on Friday dropped your bank's identifier; the fix is being deployed and retried transfers should settle by end of day. Customer, Monday 13:05: Thank you. Please confirm once the retries have gone through, and let us know whether the sellers will see the original date or today's date on their statements. Also, are we going to be charged the transfer fee twice? Third reply, Monday 17:48, support agent: All 41 transfers were retried and accepted by the bank at 17:20; statements will show today's date; no second fee was charged and we have credited a goodwill amount to your account. Customer, Tuesday 08:30: Confirmed, the money arrived. The sellers are relieved. We would still like a written explanation of what happened for our own records, and a heads-up in advance next time a routing change is planned.
